title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
partialText: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
partialText: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
partialText: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.

title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
partialText: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
partialText: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
partialText: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
partialText: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
partialText: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
partialText: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why. Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.

title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
partialText: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.

title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
partialText: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.

title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
partialText: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.

title: A fully programmable secure web gateway
partialText: Cloudflare Gateway and Data Loss Prevention have inherited the flexibility and power of Cloudflare Workers through our full-stack integration with the Cloudflare Developer platform.

title: Deploy with Void
partialText: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare.

title: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone
partialText: How Cloudflare and OpenAI are working together to help AI find useful content, keep up with changes, and make fewer wasted requests — making the experience better for users and website owners alike.

title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
partialText: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.

title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
partialText: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available.

title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
partialText: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.

title: Rewinding the exponential: How we keep hardware usage down
partialText: Our strategies to optimize our data pipeline throughput without compromising data quality.

title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
partialText: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export. Powered by Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow, Transformers apply those changes directly to log data before it reaches the destination.
